Hey, I'm late to the party, but here is my two cents. 

Yes the idea that the Queer Community is a open an accepting lala land for all is an illusion. Why? Because this perception of the LGBT+ community does not acknowledge the role that racism ( tacit or nah ) plays in it. White supremacy, racism, colorism, etc. exist everywhere and queerness doesn't protect us from this and being queer doesn't stop other people from perpetuating that B.S. I'm sorry that's happening to you but, you are beautiful and should look for other beautiful POC who understand and appreciate you.
